```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## R Packages



```{r packages, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)


```

## Download files

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r files, include=FALSE}
data_fastfood_sales <- read_csv("data_fastfood_sales.csv")
data_fastfood_calories <- read_csv("data_fastfood_calories.csv")

```

## Question 1

```{r Q1}
data_fastfood_sales %>% 
  mutate(prop_franchise=num_franchised_stores/unit_count) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=us_sales, y=unit_count, label=restaurant, color=prop_franchise))+
  geom_point() +
  labs(y = "Total number of stores (log 10 scale)", x = "US Sales in millions (log 10 scale)") +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10") +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10") +  
  theme_bw()  +  
  geom_text_repel(color="black") +
  guides(color = guide_colourbar(title="Proportion of stores franchised"))                  
   


# 
```


## Question 2

```{r Q2}
data_fastfood_sales %>% 
  mutate(restaurant=as.factor(restaurant), restaurant=fct_reorder(.f = restaurant, .x = average_sales,.fun = sum)) %>% 
  #mutate(average_sales=scales::label_dollar(average_sales))
  ggplot()+
  geom_col(aes(x=restaurant, y= average_sales)) +
  geom_text(aes(x=restaurant, y= average_sales, label = scales::dollar(round(average_sales, digits = 0))),  hjust = -0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar(), limits = c(0,3000)) +
  labs(x = "Restaurant", y="Average sales per unit store (in thousands)") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic()
```

## Question 3
```{r Q3, fig_width= 30, fig_height= 20}
data_fastfood_calories %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=calories, y=sodium, label=item)) +
  geom_point()+
    geom_text_repel(data = data_fastfood_calories %>%  filter(sodium>2300),
        nudge_y = 1000, 
        hjust = 1,
        direction = "both") +
  facet_wrap(~restaurant) +
  labs(x="Calories", y="Sodium (Mg)") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2300) +
  theme_bw() 

```

## Question 4
```{r Q4}
data_fastfood_calories %>% 
  mutate(is_salad=str_detect(string=item, pattern ="Salad")) %>% 
  mutate(restaurant=as.factor(restaurant) %>% fct_reorder(.x = calories, .fun = median)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=calories, y=restaurant, color=is_salad)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10") +
  labs(x="Calories (log 10 scale)", y="Restaurant") +
  #guides(color = guide_legend(title="Is the entry a salad?")) +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Is the entry a salad?", labels = c("Not a salad", "Salad")) +
  theme_bw()

 
```
## Question 5

```{r Q5}
data_fastfood_calories %>%
  filter(!restaurant=="Taco Bell") %>% 
  group_by(restaurant) %>% 
  summarise(median_sugar=median(sugar)) %>% 
  inner_join(data_fastfood_sales, by=c("restaurant"="restaurant")) %>% 
  mutate(restaurant=fct_reorder(restaurant, us_sales, .fun=sum)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=restaurant, y=us_sales)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill=median_sugar), stat="identity")  +
  labs(x="Restaurant", y="U.S. sales (in millions)") +
  scale_fill_continuous(name = "Median sugar (grams) in fast food entries") +
  theme_classic() 
```
